mapper.update: ALTER TABLE TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS GCAL_EVT_ID VARCHAR(200) NULL, ADD UNIQUE KEY IF NOT EXISTS UX_HR_INTV_GCAL (GCAL_EVT_ID)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG ( BATCH_LOG_SQ INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, BATCH_CD VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, TRIGGER_CD VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, STATUS_CD VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, START_DT DATETIME NOT NULL, END_DT DATETIME NOT NULL, FROM_DT DATE NULL, TO_DT DATE NULL, READ_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, INSERT_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UPDATE_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, SAME_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, EXCL_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, SKIP_CNT INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, SKIP_DETAIL TEXT NULL, ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(500) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (BATCH_LOG_SQ), KEY IX_BATCH_LOG_CD (BATCH_CD, START_DT) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT INTV_SQ, INTV_TM FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M WHERE GCAL_EVT_ID IS NULL AND APLY_NM = #{APLY_NM} AND INTV_DT = #{INTV_DT} ORDER BY INTV_SQ LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M (SEQ_NO, APLY_NM, INTV_DT, INTV_TM, APLY_TARGET, APLY_ROUTE, PHONE, ATTEND_ST, CAREER, RESULT_ST, GCAL_EVT_ID, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO), 0) + 1, #{APLY_NM}, #{INTV_DT}, #{INTV_TM}, #{APLY_TARGET}, #{APLY_ROUTE}, #{PHONE}, #{ATTEND_ST}, #{CAREER}, #{RESULT_ST}, #{GCAL_EVT_ID}, 'BATCH', NOW() FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M SET GCAL_EVT_ID = #{GCAL_EVT_ID}, INTV_DT = #{INTV_DT}, INTV_TM = #{INTV_TM} , APLY_TARGET = COALESCE(NULLIF(APLY_TARGET, ''), #{APLY_TARGET}) , APLY_ROUTE = COALESCE(NULLIF(APLY_ROUTE, ''), #{APLY_ROUTE}) , PHONE = COALESCE(NULLIF(PHONE, ''), #{PHONE}) , ATTEND_ST = COALESCE(NULLIF(ATTEND_ST, ''), #{ATTEND_ST}) , CAREER = COALESCE(NULLIF(CAREER, ''), #{CAREER}) , RESULT_ST = COALESCE(NULLIF(RESULT_ST, ''), #{RESULT_ST}) , UPDT_EMPLY_ID = 'BATCH', UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE INTV_SQ = #{INTV_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG (BATCH_CD, TRIGGER_CD, STATUS_CD, START_DT, END_DT, FROM_DT, TO_DT, READ_CNT, INSERT_CNT, UPDATE_CNT, SAME_CNT, EXCL_CNT, SKIP_CNT, SKIP_DETAIL, ERROR_MSG) VALUES (#{BATCH_CD}, #{TRIGGER_CD}, #{STATUS_CD}, #{START_DT}, NOW(), #{FROM_DT}, #{TO_DT}, #{READ_CNT}, #{INSERT_CNT}, #{UPDATE_CNT}, #{SAME_CNT}, #{EXCL_CNT}, #{SKIP_CNT}, #{SKIP_DETAIL}, #{ERROR_MSG})
mapper.select: SELECT BATCH_LOG_SQ, TRIGGER_CD, STATUS_CD , DATE_FORMAT(START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS START_DT , TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, START_DT, END_DT) AS ELAPSED_SEC , DATE_FORMAT(FROM_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS FROM_DT , DATE_FORMAT(TO_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TO_DT , READ_CNT, INSERT_CNT, UPDATE_CNT, SAME_CNT, EXCL_CNT, SKIP_CNT, SKIP_DETAIL, ERROR_MSG FROM TB_EEP_BATCH_LOG WHERE BATCH_CD = #{BATCH_CD} ORDER BY BATCH_LOG_SQ DESC LIMIT 30
